Definition: active participle of G622; a destroyer (i.e. Satan):--Apollyon.
BiblicalUsage: The name is given once, in Revelation 9:11. The locusts from the bottomless pit have a king over them, the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon — the Destroyer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two names say the same thing in two tongues: the king of the pit is destruction itself, and his name is his nature.
